N. of a class of sacred works (supposed to have been compiled by the poet Vyāsa and to treat of 5 topics [cf. पञ्च-लक्षण]; the chief Purāṇas are 18, grouped in 3 divisions: viz. 1. Rājasa exalting Brahmā [e.g. the Brahma, Brahmâṇḍa, Brahmavaivarta, Mārkaṇḍeya, Bhaviṣya, Vāmana]; 2. Sāttvika exalting Viṣṇu [e.g. the Viṣṇu, Bhāgavata, Nāradīya, Garuḍa, Padma, Varāha]; 3. Tāmasa exalting Śiva [e.g. the Śiva, Liṅga, Skanda, Agni or in place of it the Vāyu, Matsya, Kūrma]; by some the P° are divided into 4, and by others into 6 groups; cf. IW. 509 &c.)

प्लीहन् [Orig. स्प्लीहन्; cf. Gk. σπλήν, σπλάγχνον; Lat. lien for splihen; Slav. slezena for splezena; Eng. spleen.]

प्लु: प्लु cl. 1. Ā. (Dhātup. xxii, 62; cf. xiv, 40) प्ल॑वते (rarely P. °ति; pf. पुप्लुवे, Br. &c., 3. pl. वुः, Hariv.; aor. अप्लोष्ट, Br. &c., 2. pl. अप्लोढ्वम्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 78 Sch.; Prec. प्लोषीष्ट, vii, 2, 43 Sch.; fut. प्लोष्यति, °ते, Br. &c.; ind.p. -प्लू॑य, ŚBr.; -प्लुत्य, MBh. &c.), to float, swim, RV. &c. &c.; to bathe, MBh.; Ragh.; to go or cross in a boat, sail, navigate, MBh.; Hariv.; to sway to and fro, hover, soar, fly, Br.; MBh.; Hariv.; to blow (as the wind), MBh.; Var.; to pass away, vanish by degrees, ŚBr.; R. (v.l.); to be lengthened or prolated (as a vowel See प्लुत), RPrāt.; ĀpŚr. Sch.;  (older form प्रु q.v.) to hop, skip, leap, jump, spring from (abl.) or to or into or over or upon (acc.), MBh.; R. &c.: Caus. प्लावयति (rarely °ते, or प्लवयति; aor. अपिप्लवत्, Bhaṭṭ., अपुप्ल्° Gr.), to cause to float or swim, bathe, wash, inundate, submerge, KātyŚr.; MBh. &c. ; to overwhelm i.e. supply abundantly with (instr.), MBh.; to wash away, remove (guilt, sin &c.), MBh.; BhP.; to purify, MBh.; to prolate (a vowel), ŚrS.; to cause to jump or stagger, Bhaṭṭ. : Desid. of Caus. पिप्लावयिषति or पुप्लावयिषति, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 81 : Desid. पुप्लूषते Gr.: Intens. पोप्लूयते, to swim about or rapidly, R.; Var.
प्लु [cf. Gk. πλέω, πλεϝω, πλύνω; Old Lat. per-plovere; Lat. pluit, pluvius; Lith. plauti; Angl.Sax. flovan; Germ., flawjan, flawên, vlouwen &c.]

प्लवगेन्द्र: प्लव॑—°गेन्द्र m. ‘monkey chief’, N. of Hanumat, BhP.

प्लव॑—ं-ग m. a monkey, ib.; Ṛtus.

प्लव॑—ं-ग m. a monkey, ib.; Ṛtus.
N. of the 41st (15th) year in a sixty years' cycle of Jupiter, Var.

प्लवंगम: प्लव॑—ं-गम m. (cf. prec.) a frog, R.; Hariv.
प्लवंगमा: प्लव॑—ं-गमा f. a kind of metre, Col.

प्लवत्व: प्लव॑—त्व n. (in astrol.) the position of a constellation in the quarter ruled by its planetary regent, VarBṛS.
प्लववत्: 1. प्लव॑—वत् ind. as with a boat, MBh.

प्लवन n. swimming, plunging into or bathing in (comp.), MBh.; Gīt.; Rājat.; Suśr.

प्लवितृ: प्ल°वितृ m. a leaper (with gen. of distance), R.

filling a vessel to overflowing (for the purification of fluids), L.

प्लावित: प्ला°वित mfn. made to swim or overflow, deluged, soaked, moistened or covered with (comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
lengthened, prolated (as a vowel See प्लुत), ŚrS.; BhP.
प्ला°वित n. inundation, food, deluge, Kād.
a song in which the vowels are prolated, BhP.
प्लाविन्: प्ला°विन् m. a bird or a deer, L.
प्लाव्य: प्ला°व्य mfn. to be bathed or steeped in (instr.), Var.
to be jumped or leaped, W.

a leap, jump, Śak. i, 7 v.l. (also met.; cf. मण्डूक-प्ल्°)
capering, curvet (one of a horse's paces), L.

प्लुष्ट: प्लुष्ट mfn. burned, scorched, singed, Ṛtus.; Var.; Suśr.

प्लोक्: प्लोक् ind. onomat. sounds used for a Nidhana, Drāhy.
प्लोत: प्लोत m. or n. (?) cloth, stuff

(Dhātup. xxiv, 47) प्सा॑ति (Impv. प्साहि, प्सातु, AV.; pf. पप्सौ Gr.; aor. अप्सासीत्, Bhaṭṭ.; Prec. प्सायात्, ŚBr.; or प्सेयात् Gr.; fut. प्सास्यति, प्साता, ib.; ind.p. -प्सा॑य, Br.; Pass. impf. अप्सीयत, ib.), to chew, swallow, devour, eat, consume; to go, Naigh. ii, 14.
